<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Maximum data length before starting a new card for RLD and TXT data.</p>


<p>The maximum number of bytes that can be included in an RLD or TXT record and their continuations is a SIGNED 16 bit int despite what the spec says. The number of bytes we allow ourselves to attach to a card is thus arbitrarily limited to 32K-1 bytes.</p>


<p>Definition at line 39 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/binaryformat/goff-h">GOFF.h</a>.</p>
